$comment: Single source of truth for the Featured Projects section of README.md.
Edit this file, then run `npm run cards` (or let the project-cards workflow run) to
regenerate the block between <!-- PROJECTS:START --> and <!-- PROJECTS:END -->.
Image resolution order for each project, first match wins:
1. assets/projects/<slug>.png  ..  if the file exists it is always used.
Drop your own screenshot here to control the card.
2. `live` URL                  ..  CI screenshots it into assets/projects/<slug>.png.
3. neither                     ..  the card renders as text only, no broken image.
slug      required, lowercase. Also the screenshot filename.
repo      owner/name. Omit or null when the repo is private or you don't want a link.
private   true renders a 'Private repository' note and never emits a repo link.
live      public demo URL, or null.
featured  true = card in the main grid. false = compact mention line underneath.
role      optional, e.g. for collaborations where you are not the repo owner.
